- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Adrian Stimson created paintings that combine traditional Plains Indian ledger art with modern pop culture images, such as "Parked Pow Wow Princess."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lauren Crazybull works in various mediums and incorporates traditional Blackfoot motifs into her pieces, drawing inspiration from contemporary urban life, exemplified in her "Everything is a Ceremony" artwork series.
